_help: Edit this file to update the site. status must be one of: Researching, Visit planned, Visited, Applying, Submitted, Accepted, Waitlisted, Declined. rank is a number or null. done lists finished checklist items.

Frank Sinatra School of the Arts
Brooklyn High School of the Arts
Beacon High School
schools.notes: Attend the Admissions Written Response on Nov 23 at 6pm. Confirm location and what to bring.

schools.name: High School of Fashion Industries
schools.test: Art portfolio, same as above (includes sandwich drawing)
schools.notes: Confirm program, address and dates on MySchools.

portfolio.title: Art portfolio (4 to 8 pieces)
portfolio.intro: One portfolio can be used for several schools in the same art discipline. Photograph each piece. Check MySchools for upload rules and the current year's dates.

items.title: Self-portrait
items.detail: Graphite pencil on paper, drawn from observation (look in a mirror).

items.title: Still life
items.detail: At least 3 items, graphite pencil on paper, from observation.

items.title: Figure drawing
items.detail: Graphite pencil on paper. A friend or family member can pose. Draw the whole figure, fill the page, add background.

items.title: Extra piece (your choice)
items.detail: Any material, 2D or 3D. Pieces 4 to 7 are optional, add 1 to 4.

items.title: Creative drawing: a fantastical sandwich
items.detail: Pencil on paper, with a background, fill the page. Colored pencils allowed. Required for Art and Design, LaGuardia, Frank Sinatra and Fashion Industries. Optional for other programs.

items.title: Student introduction
items.detail: Choose 3 of your pieces (must include pieces 1 and 2). Make a video of 3 minutes or less, or write up to 500 words: subject and materials, motivation, influences.
